summary: The morning session. Doors at 10, install fest straight away.
address: Level 1, Suite 26, 479 Warrigal Road, Moorabbin VIC 3189

activities.title: Install fest
activities.description: Got a laptop that can't run Windows 11? It isn't rubbish, and you don't have to replace it. Bring it along, we'll put Linux on it, and it'll be faster than it was. Older Macs too, the ones Apple has stopped updating. USB sticks provided.

activities.title: Bring a question
activities.description: Beginner questions are the whole point! Members have been doing this for decades and nobody will assume you know anything. Ask about the software that annoys you, or the subscription that keeps creeping up.

summary: The afternoon session. Drop in whenever suits and stay as long as you like.

activities.title: Install fest
activities.description: Got a laptop that can't run Windows 11? It isn't rubbish, and you don't have to replace it. Bring it along, we'll put Linux on it, and it'll be faster than it was. Older Macs too, the ones Apple has stopped updating. USB sticks provided.

activities.title: Open exchange
activities.description: Beginner questions are the whole point! Bring the software that annoys you, or the subscription that keeps creeping up, and we'll talk about what else is out there. The alternatives are usually free, and they aren't mining your files to train an AI.

activities.title: Lightning talks
activities.description: Five minutes each, no slides required but welcomed. Show us an open source app you love, something you fixed, or something you're still figuring out. It doesn't have to be technical. Put your name down on the day.
